description: Impact groups are conservative dependency closures. Unmapped/shared inputs run the complete suite. Every lane runs the one supported `python` version, its shards as separate jobs and each shard in `workers` processes. Measured per-test reports weigh the partition; test_seconds keeps, per runner operating system, the tests that took at least five seconds (refresh it with `tools/ci_tests.py estimates`) for a plan whose policy changed, and every other test weighs default_seconds.
